episode_summary: In this episode, Frances Katzen discusses the current trends in the New York real estate market, emphasizing the importance of having a strong opinion and being candid with clients. She shares insights on building a successful market report and leveraging media appearances to enhance personal branding. Frances also addresses the impact of the pied-à-terre tax and how agents can navigate these changes to maintain a competitive edge.
